description: This file manages cron store data, including loading, saving, path resolution, and backup handling for cron jobs, with functions for file operations and JSON parsing.

methods.name: resolveDefaultCronDir
methods.description: Resolves the default directory for cron jobs based on configuration.

methods.name: resolveDefaultCronStorePath
methods.description: Resolves the default path for the cron jobs JSON file.

methods.name: stripRuntimeOnlyCronFields
methods.description: Removes runtime-only fields from cron job objects for comparison.

methods.name: parseCronStoreForBackupComparison
methods.description: Parses raw JSON string into CronStoreFile object for backup comparison.

methods.name: shouldSkipCronBackupForRuntimeOnlyChanges
methods.description: Determines if cron backup should be skipped based on runtime-only changes.

methods.name: resolveCronStorePath
methods.description: Resolves the path to the cron store, handling tilde expansion and defaults.

methods.name: loadCronStore
methods.description: Loads the cron store from a file, parsing JSON and handling errors.

methods.name: saveCronStore
methods.description: Saves the cron store to a file, with backup and file permission handling.

methods.name: renameWithRetry
methods.description: Attempts to rename a file with retries, handling specific error codes.
